title: Examining Variation in How Guided AI Tutors Resolve Student Impasses
abstract: arXiv:2609.38346v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a student is stuck, a tutor faces the assistance dilemma: help given too early can hinder productive struggle, while help withheld too long leaves the student in a frustrating, persistent impasse (i.e., wheel spinning). Generative AI tutors increasingly use guardrails restricting answer-giving, yet little is known about how such tutors behave once an impasse persists. We analyze 20,462 student turns from 1,260 authentic sessions with a guided LLM chemistry tutor, identifying 6,630 impasse turns of three major types: conceptual errors, expressed uncertainty, or help-seeking. We then used these impasses to simulate three tutoring conditions to study variation in AI tutor guidance through impasses: baseline, no-direct-answer, and guided tutor. translated_title: 考察引导型AI导师解决学生僵局方式的差异
translated_abstract: 当学生陷入困境时，导师面临“辅助困境”：过早提供帮助会阻碍学生进行有效的自主探索，而帮助延迟太久则会使学生陷入令人沮丧的持久僵局（即“空转”）。生成式AI导师越来越多地使用限制直接给出答案的护栏机制，然而对于当僵局持续存在时这类导师会如何表现，目前知之甚少。我们分析了来自1260个真实会话中引导式大语言模型化学导师的20,462个学生轮次，识别出6,630个僵局轮次，涵盖三种主要类型：概念性错误、表达不确定性以及主动求助。随后，我们利用这些僵局模拟了三种辅导条件，以研究AI导师在学生僵局中的指导差异：基线导师、禁止直接给答案的导师和引导型导师。在150个僵局样本中，提示词的具体程度改变了教学行为：基线导师在50.7%的回复中直接给出答案，而禁止直接给答案的导师每次都会提出追问……
tldr: 该研究基于1260个真实化学辅导会话并模拟三种导师条件，发现提示词的具体程度会显著改变AI导师在学生陷入僵局时的教学策略——从直接给出答案到坚持追问引导。
en_tdlr: Analyzing 20,462 student turns from 1,260 authentic chemistry tutoring sessions and simulating three tutor conditions, this study shows that prompt specificity significantly changes how guided AI tutors handle student impasses, ranging from directly giving answers to persistently asking follow-up questions.
